lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately 15-20 pixels in the mid-section, compressing to 8-10 pixels at the anterior shoulder transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcations observed on the second and fifth lines from the posterior, exhibiting Y-shaped splits near the dorsal ridge and mid-lateral region respectively.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first posterior line is composed of fragmented segments; multiple mid-torso lines terminate abruptly 10-15 pixels before the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 high-contrast spots on the lower posterior haunch with a localized density of approximately one spot per 50-pixel radius.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-haunch align into a horizontal geometric row.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking across the nasal bridge and a transverse white patch on the lower throat area.
